Vodafone Idea was created on 31 August 2018 by the [[Mergers and acquisitions|merger]] of [[Vodafone India]] and [[Idea Cellular]].{{Cite web |title=VIL Press Release - 31st August.pdf |url=https://www.vodafoneidea.com/content/dam/vodafone-microsite/docs/pdf/VIL%20Press%20Release%20-%2031st%20August.pdf |access-date=2019-07-24 |website=www.vodafoneidea.com |language=en |format=PDF}} On 20 September 2020, the two separate brands Vodafone India and Idea Cellular [[Rebranding|rebranded]] as Vodafone Idea (Vi).{{Cite web|date=2020-09-07|title=Vodafone Idea re-brands itself 'Vi'|url=https://indianexpress.com/article/business/companies/vodafone-idea-new-brand-identity-vi-key-announcements-6586229/|access-date=2020-09-07|website=The Indian Express|language=en}}{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=New brand Press Release_Media .pdf |url=https://www.vodafoneidea.com/content/dam/vodafone-microsite/docs/pdf/pressrelease/New%20brand%20Press%20Release_Media%20.pdf |access-date=2020-10-03 |website=www.vodafoneidea.com |language=en |format=PDF}}{{Cite web|date=2020-09-07|title=Vodafone Idea rebrands itself, to go by brand name Vi|url=https://zeenews.india.com/companies/vodafone-idea-rebrands-itself-to-go-by-brand-name-vi-2308087.html|access-date=2020-09-07|website=Zee News|language=en}} ==History== In March 2017, it was announced that [[Vodafone India]] and [[Idea Cellular]] would [[Mergers and acquisitions|merge]]. The merger got approval from the [[Department of Telecommunications]] in July 2018. On 30 August 2018, [[National Company Law Tribunal]] gave the final nod to the Vodafone-Idea merger.{{Cite news |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/telecom/telecom-news/nclt-gives-go-ahead-to-idea-vodafone-merger/articleshow/65616161.cms |title=NCLT gives go-ahead to Idea-Vodafone merger |last1=Parbat |first1=Kalyan |date=31 August 2018 |work=The Economic Times |access-date=1 September 2018 |last2=Sengupta |first2=Devina}} It was completed on 31 August 2018, and the new entity was named Vodafone Idea.{{cite news|title=Idea approves merger with Vodafone India, to create India's largest telco|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/companies-a-z/corporate-trends/idea-approves-merger-with-vodafone-india-to-create-indias-largest-telco/articleshow/57726194.cms|website=The Economic Times|date=20 March 2017 |access-date=20 March 2017 |last1=Guha |first1=Romit }}{{cite web|last1=Kurup|first1=Rajesh|title=Idea Cellular board approves merger with Vodafone India; shares tank 9%|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/idea-cellular-board-approves-merger-with-vodafone-india/article9591707.ece|website=The Hindu Business Line|access-date=20 March 2017|language=en|date=20 March 2017}}{{cite web |title=Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/30efb0f1-67b4-40d7-b7e8-d1c60104dd50.pdf |website=BSE |access-date=31 August 2018 }}{{Dead link|date=November 2023 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} Under the terms of the deal, the [[Vodafone]] held a 45.2% stake in the combined entity, the [[Aditya Birla Group]] held 26% and the remaining [[Share (finance)|shares]] were to be held by the public. Vodafone Idea (d/b/a Vi, pronounced   and stylized as V!) is an Indian telecommunications company headquartered in Gandhinagar. It is an all-India integrated GSM operator offering mobile telephony services.
As of July, 2026, Vi has a subscriber base of 198.82 million, making it third largest mobile telecommunications network in India and 12th largest mobile telecommunications network in the world.
Vodafone Idea was created on 31 August 2018 by the merger of Vodafone India and Idea Cellular. On 20 September 2020, the two separate brands Vodafone India and Idea Cellular rebranded as Vodafone Idea (Vi).
